notes: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, per Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). All guide text in this rebuild is written for this guide. Where no launch guide has confirmed a trophy's exact trigger, the entry is flagged 'unconfirmed' instead of inventing steps. 28 of the 55 trophies are hidden on PSN until earned; this guide's spoiler setting hides story trophies until you mark them earned.
rarityNote: No public earn rate yet: the game launched on 19 Nov 2026, so PlayStation has not published per-trophy percentages. Rarity notes will be added once real rates exist instead of guessing at them.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one awards itself: unlock the other 54 trophies and the platinum is yours. Treat A Long Road (100% completion) as the long pole in the tent — everything else on this list is shorter than that grind. PowerPyx rates the full set at 4/10 difficulty and roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the Chapter 1 opener. It unlocks on the mission end screen and cannot be missed, so just play the opening and it will be the first story trophy most players earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every Chapter 1 mission. The trophy pops as the chapter closes — keep following the story markers and there is nothing extra to set up.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy it is tied to story progress, so it unlocks naturally as you play through the campaign.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in the main story. Unmissable as long as you keep advancing the campaign.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Awarded automatically when the chapter's final mission wraps up.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Make a manual save before you start it: the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a separate save is your only way back to the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It sits in the main story flow, so it unlocks as you reach it — no detour needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist story mission. Progress-based and unmissable; it pops when the heist is done.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A main-story mission trophy that unlocks at the mission's end screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in the story. It unlocks automatically on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission. Part of the main campaign, so no special setup is required.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story progression trophy — it unlocks when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion tracker. Note that the tracker covers only part of the game's true content: launch guides count roughly 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 70 of 80 challenges toward it. This is the longest single trophy in the set and the backbone of the ~200-hour platinum estimate.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are scattered over the whole map, so clear them region by region and keep an eye on the stunt counter in your stats instead of hunting them one by one at the end.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once — races, drone races, fishing, the shooting range, bowling, arcade games and the rest. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win any of them for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Medals are kept per challenge, so retry single courses until the gold score is routine instead of redoing the whole set. Learn each weapon class's course one at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Participation is not enough here — you need an outright win at every spot, so learn each course's line first, then chase the top time.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not add to the count, so keep moving to fresh race markers across the map as you travel.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take him on at the fishing challenge, land your catches cleanly, and the trophy pops when you win the head-to-head.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Any cabinet and any game counts — play it through to completion once.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the last mission in Andy's stranger strand. Work through each of his missions as the markers appear on the map until the finale unlocks this.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Keep clearing his map markers as they appear and the finale will surface.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final stranger mission. Follow his strand job by job — the finale only appears once the earlier missions are done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The individual finale trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each count as one finished strand, so any eight strands in total will do it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final stranger mission. His strand markers appear as you progress through the game; finish the last one to pop this.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Clear his earlier jobs first — the finale only shows up once the strand is nearly complete.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the list's one possibly missable trophy: one spot is Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation, and with no mission replay and no New Game Plus, skipping that early moment may lock the trophy until a fresh playthrough. Do the Chapter 1 spot when it is offered, then sweep the remaining spots in free roam.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take his hunting request, track the animal down, and bring it in — the trophy unlocks when the hunt is delivered.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden all over the map; only finished sets count toward the three, so focus on completing sets rather than scattering single picks.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. Keep an eye out for WAiNK points while you travel and use each new one once — the counter only rises at fresh locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span most activity types, so this fills in steadily while you work on The Shootist and the 100% checklist (which itself asks for 70 of 80). Check the challenges menu to see what is closest to done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the stars and escape the heat together. Stay close to each other for the whole escape — splitting up risks the trophy not registering.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops one after another with your partner while keeping your Wanted Level alive the whole time. Plan a route of three nearby shops beforehand so the heat never fully dies between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles as you play. The full game has 277 vehicles and the 100% checklist asks for 200, so this unlocks well before the end of a completion run.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Line up a group of enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, take off from the airport without clearance. Get into an aircraft at VCIA and get airborne outside any scheduled flight.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed trigger. The description ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos') points at the Rhino tank, but no launch guide has confirmed the exact action that earns this yet. This guide will not guess — it will be updated once a source verifies the trigger.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quiet, and be out before any alarm or witness flags you — detection at any point voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. A vault only counts if you get away, so plan your exit route before you crack each vault.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit the truck, grab the cash and lose the heat — the trophy needs the getaway, not just the robbery.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — 52 areas in total. This fills in naturally on a 100% run; near the end, check the map for any region you have not set foot in yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Each gang only needs to be hit once, so keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed trigger. The description mentions enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no launch guide has confirmed the precise spot or action that earns it. Rather than invent a location, this guide flags it as unconfirmed until a source verifies the trigger.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed trigger. The description talks about smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom 'in classic style', but the exact showroom and method are not confirmed by any launch guide yet. Flagged as unconfirmed — no steps are invented here.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through: play the bowling activity there through to the end of the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partner-themed trophy ('A partnership with mass appeal'). It is earned through playing as a partnership — wanted escapes, shop robberies and other activities done together with your partner are the same family of tasks this list groups together, so keep doing things as a duo and it will register along the way.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices in dialogue and interaction prompts. Choices accumulate across the whole playthrough — pick responses instead of letting prompts time out and the counter climbs steadily toward 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed trigger. The description ('Second time's the charm') hints at failing at something and succeeding on a retry, but no launch guide has confirmed what. It stays flagged as unconfirmed here rather than guessing at a trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed trigger. Something strange is clearly behind this one ('What the hell just happened?'), but launch guides have not confirmed the event or location involved. Marked unconfirmed — this guide will not invent a spot on the map.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed trigger. The description paints a melee drive-by that bowls people over ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by'), but the exact requirements — how many, where, in what vehicle — are not confirmed by launch guides yet. Flagged as unconfirmed instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; route them through your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw and the total accumulates across the whole game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Clothing, vehicles and services all count toward the one running total, so this unlocks naturally on a long playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties. Save as you play — property purchases also feed your spending totals — and pick up each garage as it becomes available.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you get a vehicle you want to keep, register it in the app; the tenth registration unlocks the trophy.
